inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, let’s be entirely clear about the chilling escalation of state intimidation we are witnessing right now. On Tuesday, White House border czar Tom Homan appeared on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” where he openly refused to rule out deploying immigration enforcement directly to polling places. 

This is a blatant, systemic effort to suppress the votes of racialized and working-class populations. By threatening to station armed immigration agents at the ballot box, the administration is weaponizing the machinery of the state to terrorize vulnerable communities and maintain power through fear and exclusion rather than democratic engagement. When those in power demand to know what Democrats are "afraid of," they are deliberately ignoring historic and ongoing disenfranchisement. This is nothing less than an authoritarian attack on civil liberties and the fundamental right of every person to participate in society free from state-sponsored harassment.
